snippet.title: Micro Gamer Shinmy - Touhou Game Jam 13 Playthrough
snippet.description:
Very cool concept. Can't complain about the controls, since they put you right in Shinmy's mindset of how she'd have to play such a game as her size.

Game: https://gyroscopik.itch.io/micro-gamer-shinmy

Touhou Game Jam 13 Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL9kE-e82GngkTF7x__rIfJyZDQBtSQcsq
